       | khepri:data()
       | fun(), Options :: khepri:command_options()
       | khepri:tree_options()
       | khepri:put_options(), Ret :: khepri:minimal_ret()
       | khepri_machine:async_ret()
  type async_option/0 :: boolean()
       | ra_server:command_correlation()
       | ra_server:command_priority()
       | {ra_server:command_correlation(), ra_server:command_priority()}
  type async_ret/0 :: khepri_machine:write_ret()
       | khepri_tx:tx_fun_result()
       | khepri:error({not_leader, ra:server_id()})
  type child_list_length/0 :: non_neg_integer()
  type child_list_version/0 :: pos_integer()
  type command_options/0 :: #{timeout => timeout(), async => async_option(), reply_from => reply_from_option(), protect_against_dups => boolean()}
  type data/0 :: any()
  type delete_reason/0 :: explicit | keep_while
  type error/0 :: error(any())
  type error/1 :: {error, Type}
  type favor_option/0 :: consistency | low_latency
  type filter_fun/0 :: fun((khepri_path:native_path(), khepri:node_props()) -> boolean())
  type fold_acc/0 :: any()
  type fold_fun/0 :: fun((khepri_path:native_path(), khepri:node_props(), khepri:fold_acc()) -> khepri:fold_acc())
  type foreach_fun/0 :: fun((khepri_path:native_path(), khepri:node_props()) -> any())
  type known_prop_to_return/0 :: payload_version
       | child_list_version
       | child_list_length
       | child_names
       | payload
       | has_payload
       | raw_payload
       | delete_reason
  type many_payloads_ret/0 :: many_payloads_ret(undefined)
  type many_payloads_ret/1 :: khepri:ok(#{khepri_path:path() => khepri:data() | horus:horus_fun() | Default})
       | khepri:error()
  type map_fun/0 :: fun((khepri_path:native_path(), khepri:node_props()) -> khepri:map_fun_ret())
  type map_fun_ret/0 :: any()
  type minimal_ret/0 :: ok | khepri:error()
  type node_props/0 :: #{data => khepri:data(), has_data => boolean(), sproc => horus:horus_fun(), is_sproc => boolean(), payload_version => khepri:payload_version(), child_list_version => khepri:child_list_version(), child_list_length => khepri:child_list_length(), child_names => [khepri_path:node_id()], delete_reason => khepri:delete_reason()}
  type node_props_map/0 :: #{khepri_path:native_path() => khepri:node_props()}
  type ok/1 :: {ok, Type}
  type payload_ret/0 :: payload_ret(undefined)
  type payload_ret/1 :: khepri:ok(khepri:data() | horus:horus_fun() | Default) | khepri:error()
  type payload_version/0 :: pos_integer()
  type put_options/0 :: #{keep_while => khepri_condition:keep_while()}
  type query_options/0 :: #{condition => ra:query_condition(), timeout => timeout(), favor => favor_option()}
  type reply_from_option/0 :: leader | local | {member, ra:server_id()}
  type store_id/0 :: atom()
  type tree_options/0 :: #{expect_specific_node => boolean(), props_to_return => [known_prop_to_return() | unknown_prop_to_return()], include_root_props => boolean(), return_indirect_deletes => boolean()}
  type trigger_id/0 :: atom()
  type unknown_prop_to_return/0 :: atom()

module khepri_condition
  visibility hidden
  export applies_to_grandchildren/1
  export compare_numerical_values/2
  export compile/1
  export ensure_native_keep_while/1
  export eval_regex/4
  export is_met/3
  export is_valid/1
  export_type comparison_op/1
  export_type condition/0
  export_type keep_while/0
  export_type native_keep_while/0
  export_type re_compile_ret/0
  spec applies_to_grandchildren/1 applies_to_grandchildren(condition()) -> boolean()
  spec compare_numerical_values/2 compare_numerical_values(ValueA, ValueB) -> Equal when ValueA :: non_neg_integer(), ValueB :: non_neg_integer()
       | comparison_op(non_neg_integer()), Equal :: boolean()
  spec compare_numerical_values/3 compare_numerical_values(Cond, ValueA, ValueB) -> Equal when Cond :: condition_using_comparison_op(), ValueA :: non_neg_integer(), ValueB :: non_neg_integer()
       | comparison_op(non_neg_integer()), Equal :: true
       | {false, condition_using_comparison_op()}
  spec compile/1 compile(Condition) -> Condition when Condition :: khepri_path:pattern_component()
  spec ensure_native_keep_while/1 ensure_native_keep_while(KeepWhile) -> NativeKeepWhile when KeepWhile :: keep_while(), NativeKeepWhile :: native_keep_while()
  spec eval_regex/4 eval_regex(Condition, SourceRegex, CompiledRegex, Value) -> Ret when Condition :: condition_using_regex(), SourceRegex :: any
       | iodata()
       | unicode:charlist(), CompiledRegex :: khepri_condition:re_compile_ret()
       | undefined, Value :: atom()
       | iodata()
       | unicode:charlist(), Ret :: true
       | {false, condition_using_regex()}
       | {false, {condition_using_regex(), {error, match_limit | match_limit_recursion | {string(), non_neg_integer()}}}}
  spec is_met/3 is_met(Condition, PathOrChildName, Child) -> IsMet when Condition :: khepri_path:pattern_component(), PathOrChildName :: khepri_path:native_path()
       | khepri_path:component(), Child :: khepri_tree:tree_node()
       | khepri:node_props(), IsMet :: true
       | IsNotMet1
       | IsNotMet2, IsNotMet1 :: {false, khepri_path:pattern_component()}, IsNotMet2 :: {false, {condition(), any()}}
  spec is_valid/1 is_valid(Condition) -> IsValid when Condition :: khepri_path:pattern_component(), IsValid :: true
       | {false, khepri_path:pattern_component()}
  spec optimize_if_all_conditions/1 optimize_if_all_conditions([condition()]) -> [condition()]
  spec optimize_if_any_conditions/1 optimize_if_any_conditions([condition()]) -> [condition()]
  spec term_matches/2 term_matches(Term, MatchSpec) -> Matches when Term :: khepri:data(), MatchSpec :: ets:comp_match_spec(), Matches :: boolean()
  type comparison_op/1 :: {eq, Type} | {ne, Type} | {lt, Type} | {le, Type} | {gt, Type} | {ge, Type}
  type condition/0 :: if_name_matches()
       | if_path_matches()
       | if_has_payload()
       | if_has_data()
       | if_has_sproc()
       | if_data_matches()
       | if_node_exists()
       | if_payload_version()
       | if_child_list_version()
       | if_child_list_length()
       | if_not()
       | if_all()
       | if_any()
  type condition_using_comparison_op/0 :: if_payload_version() | if_child_list_version() | if_child_list_length()
  type condition_using_regex/0 :: if_name_matches() | if_path_matches()
  type if_all/0 :: #if_all{}
  type if_any/0 :: #if_any{}
  type if_child_list_length/0 :: #if_child_list_length{}
  type if_child_list_version/0 :: #if_child_list_version{}
  type if_data_matches/0 :: #if_data_matches{}
  type if_has_data/0 :: #if_has_data{}
  type if_has_payload/0 :: #if_has_payload{}
  type if_has_sproc/0 :: #if_has_sproc{}
  type if_name_matches/0 :: #if_name_matches{}
  type if_node_exists/0 :: #if_node_exists{}
  type if_not/0 :: #if_not{}
  type if_path_matches/0 :: #if_path_matches{}
  type if_payload_version/0 :: #if_payload_version{}
  type keep_while/0 :: #{khepri_path:path() => condition()}
  type native_keep_while/0 :: #{khepri_path:native_path() => condition()}
  type re_compile_ret/0 :: {ok, {re_pattern, any(), any(), any(), any()}}
       | {error, {string(), non_neg_integer()}}
